description: This file defines the class 'Smarty_Internal_Runtime_Make_Nocache', which provides methods for handling 'nocache' variables in Smarty templates, specifically saving and storing variable states during template rendering.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_Make_Nocache
classes.description: Runtime methods for handling 'nocache' variables during Smarty template processing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current value of a template variable and injects 'nocache' code into the output.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores a variable's value in the template's cache context, initializing a new Smarty_Variable if necessary.
